title: Session-wants baseline — decide the work from data
goal: First ML pass over the structured wants extracted from each AI agent's sessions. EDA over intensity / cluster / agent, then a small sklearn baseline that predicts a want's cluster from its title. This is the seed of the Muse-side role "decide what to do from data" (wants -> intent -> order).
next_action: Load data/bronze/wants.jsonl (12 rows: grok 6 + muse 6, generated by src/ml_sessions_intent/extract_wants.py) and run EDA — counts by agent, cluster and status, intensity distribution, depends_on/enables graph. Then TF-IDF + logistic regression for title -> cluster as baseline. Kaggle run follows the earlier decision: driven from Muse, tokens later.
notes: Index-only first: no transcript text, only structured wants and the session-file index (extract_sessions_index.py). Canonical stays in this repo's YAML; JSONL is the derived bronze layer. (Renamed from INTENT-2026-11-11-02 to avoid id collision with ml-repos-analyze-port.)
